text:
maria: Quick proposal: build a waterfall chart that stacks latency buckets (p50/p95/p99) per model config and overlays unit cost ($/1k tokens). Hero slide for webinar + simplified static for blog.

alex: Yes — show hosted vs dedicated side-by-side. customers always ask about production cost. :eyes: 

maria: Include three model families: redwood-small, redwood-med, open-xl. annotate where caching/batching change both latency and cost.

sam: Axes: left Y latency (ms), right Y $/1k tokens. X = model+config. Bars = p50/p95/p99 stacked; line = cost.
jordan: Add dashed fallback line showing routing to cheaper variant when SLOs break (frames graceful degradation).
liv: Headline options: "Latency vs Unit Economics: Real Production Benchmarks" OR "Slash Tail Latency, Protect Your Budget". Which do we use?

alex: Second for paid social — punchier.
sam: Data request to eng/runtime: CSV with p50/p95/p99 and cost_per_1k for hosted/dedicated with cache_on flag. benchbot: run link https://bench.internal/runs/6823/summary

benchbot: run 6823 CSV attached: models=[redwood-small,redwood-med,open-xl], fields=[p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_on,deploy_type].

maria: Deliverables: (1) Hero waterfall slide (PNG + editable) (2) Social static + 3 copy variants (A/B/C) (3) Landing blurb + signup routing. Routing rule: if product_interest=Dedicated OR company_size>=200 -> route to SDR; else marketing nurture.
jordan: Form should have radio: Hosted / Dedicated / Unsure. If Unsure + company_size>=200 -> SDR. Keep tags simple.
liv: Social copy drafts:
A: "See how smart routing slashes tail latency — and cuts token costs. Join our live demo."
B: "Faster responses, lower bills: real-world benchmarks from Redwood Inference."
C: "Production latency vs price — pragmatic tradeoffs, live walkthrough."
alex: A for paid, B organic, C webinar description.
sam: Figma mock notes:
X labels: [rs-small, rs-med, open-xl]
Bars: p50 light blue, p95 teal, p99 navy (stacked)
Line: cost_per_1k orange (right axis)
Callouts: "Prefix caching -> ~2x lower cost", "Fallback to lightweight model at p99"
jordan: Add small panel: monthly bill example for 10M tokens per config so readers see $ impact.
maria: Timeline: need final assets by Wed EOD for Thu AM invite. Owners: sam=chart+csv, liv=copy+images, alex=landing+routing, jordan=SDR mapping. Drop final copy in #content-review for approvals. :rocket:
